name: Aibar / Oibar (Spain)
description: Red field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Aibar (a castle above crossed keys on red).
history: Municipal flag of Aibar/Oibar; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
